lib/services/admin.ts.name: Dashboard overview
lib/services/admin.ts.description: Pulls together the headline numbers and pending enquiries the admin dashboard shows when it first loads.

lib/services/analytics.ts.name: Product view tracking
lib/services/analytics.ts.description: Records which products each visitor looks at and uses that history to show recently-viewed and trending items.

lib/services/cart.ts.name: Shopping bag
lib/services/cart.ts.description: Adds, updates, and removes items in a customer's shopping bag and keeps the running item count.

lib/services/email.ts.name: Order and alert emails
lib/services/email.ts.description: Sends the team an email when a new order arrives, a waitlist signup happens, or something else needs attention.

lib/services/inventory.ts.name: Stock management
lib/services/inventory.ts.description: Tracks how many of each product are in stock, reserves items during checkout, and flags anything running low.

lib/services/leads.ts.name: Bespoke enquiry leads
lib/services/leads.ts.description: Stores and manages custom-design enquiries so the team can review, update, and follow up on each one.

lib/services/orders.ts.name: Order records
lib/services/orders.ts.description: Creates new orders after payment, looks them up by number or customer, and lets the team update their status.

lib/services/wishlist.ts.name: Customer wishlist
lib/services/wishlist.ts.description: Lets signed-in customers save products to a personal wishlist and check whether an item is already saved.
